player.//: Movement (src/sim/player/player.ts). A sprint's force-velocity profile: propulsion accel (m/s^2) from a standstill, falling linearly to zero at the top speed for the direction run relative to where the player looks (the ball): maxSpeed forward, sideSpeed sideways (crossover steps, head turned), backSpeed backpedalling. brake: hardest deceleration; grip: all horizontal acceleration (braking, turning, pushing) together, the shoe on sand-filled turf (mu about 0.9). Match data (Miralles et al. 2025, 83 WPT men, inertial units): top speed in a match median 15.2 km/h (4.2 m/s), peak acceleration 4.6 and deceleration -4.5 m/s^2 (tracker-smoothed), about 395 accelerations an hour, 80% of them over 1-2 m. Those tracker peaks are sub-maximal (smoothed, and players rarely go flat out); the body can do more: from rest, 5 m takes about 1.3 s here, as court-sport athletes' sprint tests give once the timing-gate start is allowed for. The AI uses full effort only when the time left asks for it. sideSpeed, backSpeed and grip are estimates (no published padel figures).

timing.//: Half-widths of the grade windows in seconds; scaled by the timing-window setting.
